description: Tell tday whether you will carry on recording the demo by yourself, or are waiting for the developer or stuck, and why. tday shows it on the page the developer is watching, which tells them to come back to you. Call it every time you stop or hand back to the developer before the demo is uploaded: when you wait for their OK on what demo_check found (waiting, needs_ok_on_check), when you ask them anything else (waiting, question), when something is in your way you cannot get past (blocked, with the reason). Call it with continuing once you go on by yourself (after their OK, or when nothing needed it). Not needed after demo_upload. The note is shown to the developer as you write it: a few plain sentences on what you need from them; never a key, password, token, env value or private host.

brandId.description: The brand, when this token is a person's key rather than a capture prompt's

note.description: Optional, up to 600 characters, shown to the developer: what you found and what you need from them, in plain words. No keys, passwords, tokens, env values or private hosts

reason.description: Why you are waiting or blocked (needed unless continuing). needs_ok_on_check: you told the developer what demo_check found and wait for their OK; question: you asked the developer something else and wait for the answer; cant_start_app: the app will not start or build for the take; missing_tool: something the take needs is missing on this machine (a browser, ffmpeg, Xcode, a permission); not_product_repo: this folder is not the product's code, or you cannot find the app to demo; needs_login_or_data: the app needs a login, demo data or a seed you do not have; needs_restart: tday's tools need a reload or restart of you to work; tday_refused: tday refused (the token, the brand or the plan); other: anything else: say what in the note

repoDir.description: The repo the demo is of (default: the current directory), to find its brand

state.description: continuing: you will record and upload by yourself. waiting: you handed back to the developer and wait for their answer. blocked: you cannot go on as things are

name: demo_status
title: Tell tday what you are doing
